notes: Bulgarian payroll parameters for employee net-pay math (effective 2026). Employee social contributions total 13.78% (III категория труд, born after 1959) plus a 10% flat income tax; social contributions are capped at the maximum insurable income (the income-tax base is NOT capped). Legislative constants — there is no machine-readable feed; maintained as a dated table in pipeline/src/vyarno_pipeline/payroll.py. State Social Insurance Budget Act 2026 (ЗБДОО 2026), adopted by the National Assembly on 2026-07-22, in force 2026-08-01: the maximum insurable income rises to €2300 for all insured persons. Contribution rates, the 10% flat tax and the €620.20 minimum wage are unchanged from 2026-01-01.
